project.name: AI Leverage Library
project.purpose: A Git-native, evidence-aware library of reproducible AI techniques organized by outcome rather than provider.
project.primaryUser: Practitioners and AI agents seeking reproducible, authority-bounded AI workflows
project.problemSolved: Useful AI workflows are commonly scattered across prompts, demonstrations, and tribal knowledge without reproducible verification or explicit human authority boundaries.
project.stage: 0.1.0 repository scaffold with one seed technique; product use and organizational value are UNVERIFIED
project.deploymentTarget: UNVERIFIED - a static documentation site or PWA is specified, but no provider or deployment configuration exists

goals.statement: Maintain portable technique cards, catalogs, and evidence contracts that fail visibly when their structural claims drift.
Enable a practitioner or agent to find, apply, and verify an appropriate technique without hidden context.
Make technique publication and lifecycle promotion reproducible, reviewable, and resistant to evidence inflation.
Demonstrate that the library improves real AI-assisted work through retained outcome evidence.

capabilities.name: Canonical technique cards
capabilities.description: Store outcome-oriented technique definitions under content/techniques with explicit verification, risk, and human authority fields.
capabilities.owner_or_authority: Repository maintainers; human review for authority changes and field-tested promotion

capabilities.name: Technique contract and catalog drift validation
capabilities.description: Check required card metadata, allowed values, unique IDs, category placement, and catalog agreement.

evidence.detail: The exact committed snapshot passed technique and project-state validation on 2026-08-25

capabilities.name: Human-readable and machine-readable catalog
capabilities.description: Expose published technique metadata in CATALOG.md and catalog.yaml while cards remain canonical.

capabilities.name: Constraint Compilation workflow
capabilities.description: Turn scattered constraints into an inspectable, authority-bounded outcome contract.

evidence.detail: Workflow and verification are documented; no retained trial is present

capabilities.owner_or_authority: Human reviewer for any promotion beyond specified

capabilities.name: Pull-request and main-branch validation configuration
capabilities.description: Configure GitHub Actions to run repository validation on pull requests and pushes to main.
capabilities.owner_or_authority: GitHub Actions provider acknowledgement is required for operational proof

capabilities.name: Searchable documentation site or PWA
capabilities.description: Provide a searchable user-facing adapter over the portable content core.

capabilities.name: Codex skill adapter
capabilities.description: Retrieve and apply relevant canonical techniques through a Codex skill.

capabilities.name: Catalog CLI
capabilities.description: Support search, creation, recommendation, and validation from a small command-line adapter.

capabilities.name: MCP adapter
capabilities.description: Expose stabilized catalog and retrieval contracts through an MCP server.

evidence.detail: Explicitly deferred until catalog and retrieval contracts stabilize

capabilities.name: Canonical project state and drift detection
capabilities.description: Keep project intent, capability state, decisions, blockers, proof, and uncertainty machine-checkable and human-readable.

evidence.detail: Local structural and drift checks passed

capabilities.owner_or_authority: Repository maintainers; semantic state changes require evidence and any designated human gate

capabilities.name: Experiment, playbook, and case-study retention scaffolds
capabilities.description: Provide locations and templates for trials, reusable sequences, outcomes, and useful failures.

journeys.name: Discover and apply a governed AI technique
journeys.trigger: A practitioner or AI agent has an outcome or problem suited to an AI-assisted workflow
journeys.actor: Practitioner or AI agent under human authority
journeys.action: Find a technique, supply required inputs, execute its workflow, and perform claim-matched verification
journeys.stateChange: An ad hoc AI attempt becomes a bounded, inspectable workflow result
journeys.authorityOrEvidence: Technique card, retained verification evidence, and required human review
journeys.nextState: Retain a result or experiment and reassess the technique's evidence status
journeys.outcome: A useful result whose limits and authority are explicit
missingProof: No retained independent user application or measured outcome exists in the repository

journeys.name: Author and publish a technique
missingProof: A retained example of a newly published technique completing the entire review workflow

decisions.summary: Technique cards are canonical; catalogs are derived navigation.
Organize techniques by outcomes rather than vendors or models.
Evidence levels and human authority gates constrain lifecycle promotion.
Keep websites, skills, CLIs, and MCP servers as adapters over a portable content core.
The public repository grants no reuse license unless a separate license is added.

integrations.name: Git
evidence: Repository metadata identifies main as the active branch

integrations.name: Node.js
evidence: package.json requires Node >=20 and validation scripts use node:fs and node:path

risks.summary: Technique value may remain a documentation claim without retained trials and observed outcomes.
evidence: No experiment or case-study entry exists at reconciliation

risks.summary: The seed card's experimental status exceeds the documented promotion evidence currently present.
evidence: content/techniques/discover/constraint-compilation.md says experimental and concept; CONTRIBUTING.md requires a bounded trial

risks.summary: Public visibility may be mistaken for permission to reuse despite the all-rights-reserved license.

blockers.summary: No retained bounded trial or independent user outcome proves the seed technique or primary journey.
evidence: content/experiments contains no experiment records; content/case-studies contains no case studies
blockers.resolutionCondition: Complete the next proof event with retained inputs, output, verification, and human review evidence.

blockers.summary: No named reviewer, design partner, or adopting organization is recorded for outcome acceptance.
evidence: Repository documentation assigns human review but names no owner or adopter
blockers.resolutionCondition: Record an authorized reviewer and a bounded target workflow for the next proof event.

proofEvents.name: Independent governed use of Constraint Compilation
proofEvents.whyItMatters: It is the smallest event that can distinguish a well-structured technique card from a technique that creates reproducible user value.
prerequisites: Name an authorized reviewer and bounded real workflow
Record the trial without secrets or proprietary material
acceptanceCriteria: A practitioner who did not author the card follows the canonical workflow
Every compiled constraint traces to supplied evidence
The result preserves scope and authority boundaries
A human reviewer accepts or rejects the output against the documented contract

commercialEvidence.claim: The library improves the quality or speed of real AI-assisted work.

nextActions.action: Select a bounded real workflow and independent practitioner for PROOF-001.
Run and retain the trial, including negative evidence and human disposition.
Reconcile the seed technique status and adapter roadmap from the trial evidence without automatic promotion.
